g.text: Isolation barrier (red dashes): PS1, U3, U4

g.desc: Isolation barrier (red dashes): PS1, U3, U4

g.text: R8 (LED of U3): value set once the Linap VCC is measured, (VCC - 1.2 V) / 2.5 mA. Not fitted until then.

g.desc: R8 (LED of U3): value set once the Linap VCC is measured, (VCC - 1.2 V) / 2.5 mA. Not fitted until then.

g.text: Transmit: GPIO4 high pulls DATA low through U4 (open collector), so the UART is inverted on transmit.

g.desc: Transmit: GPIO4 high pulls DATA low through U4 (open collector), so the UART is inverted on transmit.

g.text: Never plug USB while on mains: the C3 5 V pin is tied to VBUS.
